body:
### Default amount never recaps

When the order entry page mounts before a valid price, the form prefills the uncapped trading default and sets `hasSetInitialAmount`. After price and `getMaxAllowedAmount` resolve, the capped `initialAmountValue` is never applied.
action: Re-apply capped default when price resolves after mount.

body:
### Modal closes before persist

`PerpsSlippageConfigModal` calls `onClose()` right after `onSave`, while the page's `onSave` only persists via async `setMaxSlippage`.
action: Await async onSave before closing the slippage config modal.

body:
### Slippage hook kills order book

When slippage estimation turns off, `usePerpsLiveOrderBook` cleanup deactivates the global stream still needed for limit mid-price.
action: Pass manageStream: false from the slippage estimation hook.

body:
### Max slippage defaults while loading

Slippage UI used default cap before controller preference finished loading.
action: Gate slippage display and submit blocking on max-slippage loading state.

body:
### Price load resets user amount

Manual amount edits were overwritten when price later resolved.
action: Set hasSetInitialAmount on manual edits to prevent price-load overwrite.

body:
### Throttled book stale after symbol

Throttled L2 data could remain from the prior market after symbol change.
action: Reset throttled order book via symbol resetKey on asset switch.

body:
### Stale slippage submit error

Successful max-slippage save did not clear a prior slippage submit error.
action: Clear submitError after successful max-slippage save from config modal.

body:
### Order book depth not requested

Order entry stream activation omitted slippage estimate book depth parameters.
action: Pass SlippageEstimateBookLevels on order-book stream activation.

body:
### Stale slippage ignores readiness

Order entry ignored isReady and could use stale estimate after symbol change.
action: Gate exceedsMaxSlippage and Est/Max row on isEstimatedSlippageReady.

body:
### Clears slippage error too broadly

setSubmitError(null) after save cleared errors even when the new cap still did not cover the live estimate.
action: Only clear submit error after save when the new cap covers the live estimate.

body:
### Pending slippage max shows incorrectly

Pending slippage row used '--' for max even after max slippage resolved, hiding the configured cap while estimate loads.
action: Show resolved max percent in pending row while estimate is still loading.
